goal: 在 E 维度新建第二个 Theme E.2「外来文明与造物技术的跨文化传入」与 E.2.1／E.2.2／E.2.3 三个 Topic，把东汉佛教东传至明末清初西学东渐之间的 19 个 KU 按“宗教传播—商贸流通—传教士知识网络”三种载体集中挂载。
unresolved: RD-UNITS-MISSING-HIERARCHY-ASSIGNMENT: 2382
RD-SINGLE-SOURCE-UNITS: 1919
RD-TENTATIVE-UNITS: 2570
RD-LOW-CONFIDENCE-UNITS: 496
OPP-ISOLATED: 1421
Buddhist transmission: the source gives the three-route account and the Eastern Han date, but does not give the route-by-route evidence or the dating argument for the art works

Kongwangshan cliff carvings: confidence is low, the dating range and the Buddha-image identification are not settled in the source, and its relation to the Eastern Han Buddhist entry remains an inference
Niya site: the source records the wax-resist cotton cloth but gives no excavation context, dating evidence or production-site argument; the Hellenistic-style pattern reading is not argued
Baoyi-bodai: the term is anchored to Yungang Buddha costume, but the source does not trace how the Chinese costume form was transposed onto Buddhist iconography
Zhang Qian and Zheng He: both are recorded as route-opening events, but the source does not give the object lists, technology transfer items or the receiving-side records
Sixth-century textile and dyeing technique outflow: recorded through the 'Jingxing Ji' passage only; the technique names, the craftsmen and the destination workshops are absent
Jianzhen: the 85 accompanying craftsmen are recorded, but their trades, the techniques they carried and the Japanese-side reception are not detailed
Islamic culture: cobalt and glaze influence is asserted, but the source does not separate imported material from imported technique or local imitation
Dutch East India Company: recorded as a trade channel for export porcelain; the ordering system, the pattern requirements and the volume data are absent
Tom Piquinte: records European reception of Chinese lacquer, which is the reverse direction; the source gives no date, workshop or specific object
Hyksos: a non-Chinese diffusion reference only; it is not evidence of a foreign source for Chinese craft
Matteo Ricci: clocks and other instruments are recorded, but the source does not give the transmission chain from mission to court workshop
Yuánxi Qíqì Túshuō: the book is recorded, but its technical content, the illustrations' source and its actual influence on Chinese mechanics are not argued
Tang Ruowang and Nan Huairen: both rest on very thin single-source mentions with confidence low; their specific technical contributions are not recorded
Dechang lace workshop: recorded as an Italian lace technique entry, but the founding date, the technology-transfer mechanism and the product market are absent
Johannes Gutenberg: a Western comparison only; the source does not compare Chinese and Western movable type beyond a single sentence
No mediating evidence links 'foreign objects, techniques or texts entered China' to 'a change in Chinese design practice'; the Theme does not treat transmission as proof of transformation

Chinoiserie, foreign-style architecture, Chinese-Western hybrid architecture, qipao, hufu, foot-binding reform, early industrialization, the Self-Strengthening Movement, the Opium War and other E-dimension entries remain unmounted; dimension E does not close because E.2 exists
2382 KUs remain unmounted; E.2 covers only 19 KUs
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Theme（E.2）与 3 个 Topic（E.2.1、E.2.2、E.2.3），挂载 19 个 KU：佛教传入、孔望山摩崖造像、尼雅遗址、褒衣博带入 E.2.1；张骞出使西域、郑和下西洋、6 世纪纺织印染技术外传、《经行记》、鉴真、伊斯兰文化、荷兰东印度公司、汤姆·齐平特、喜克索斯人入 E.2.2；利玛窦、《远西奇器图说》、汤若望、南怀仁、德昌花边庄、约翰·古腾堡入 E.2.3。E.2 按“宗教传播—商贸流通—传教士知识网络”三种载体分层，并区分“器物传入”“技术传入”“文献传入”三种形态；汤姆·齐平特、喜克索斯人、约翰·古腾堡标 `boundary_case`，分别表示中国工艺在域外的接受、非中国的技术扩散参照与西方活字印刷对照，不写入中国设计史内部证据。未新增 KU、claim、candidate 或来源字节，未改写 03基础书籍-md文档/ 与 02-sources/，未执行 commit 或 push。
